cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You always forget to eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then they'll keep you well as long as you choose to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only because I want the last thing you hear here to be kindness.
